newsitem.title: USA: BANKAMERICA WAIVES LIABILITY ON DEBIT CARDS.
newsitem.headline: BANKAMERICA WAIVES LIABILITY ON DEBIT CARDS.

text.p: SAN FRANCISCO - BankAmerica Corp said it will cover the liability incurred by its customers for unauthorized transactions on the bank's popular debit and ATM cards.
Previously, customers were potentially liable for $50 or more, depending on circumstances, the company said.
BankAmerica said the new policy is effective immediately.
The new policy eliminates liability currently permitted to be imposed on customers by federal regulations.
Under those regulations, liability for debit and ATM cards ranges from $50 up to the full amount of unauthorized transactions that are not reported within a specified time.
